title: Instrument GPU queueing and backpressure span propagation
author: Ava Chen
description: Context: Customers have intermittent tail-latency incidents attributed to unseen GPU-side queueing and scheduler backpressure. Existing telemetry exposed per-invocation latency and kernel timings but lacked per-device queue depth, kernel wait-time histograms, and an end-to-end trace showing where scheduler backpressure cascades into request stalls. Motivation: provide deterministic signals for (1) detecting kernel saturation before request SLOs are violated, (2) surface backpressure spans across scheduler -> runtime -> GPU driver boundary, and (3) reduce alert noise by tuning thresholds using real queue metrics. Changes in this PR: added a Prometheus collector for per-GPU queue depth and producer/consumer rates; emit OTLP spans at scheduler enqueue/dequeue points with a backpressure.reason tag; propagate a lightweight backpressure_trace_id through KV cache and runtime worker handoff; add kernel_wait_time histogram and per-queue tail-percentile gauges; new Grafana dashboard panels (device queue depth heatmap, enqueue/dequeue rate timeseries, kernel wait waterfall) and an alerting rule that triggers when device queue depth > 90% for 30s AND kernel_wait_p95 > 200ms. Rollout plan: feature gated via telemetry.enable_gpu_queue_metrics (default: false) and staged rollout to dedicated infra then hosted canaries for 48h. Observability: dashboards and alerts added; playbook drafted (link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2301) for runbook steps and mitigation (scale-up, redistribute shards, apply per-tenant throttles). Testing: unit tests for collectors and propagator, e2e integration against a synthetic kernel-saturation bench, manual verification on a dedicated pool. Backwards compatibility: propagation uses optional header and degrades to no-op for older runtimes. Risk: low-risk telemetry addition; a potential perf impact from extra metrics is mitigated by sampling and batching in the collector. See changed_files for code pointers and short snippets. Merge: squash-merged after two approvals and CI green.
commits: add: prometheus collector for gpu queue depth and rates
feat: emit otel spans at scheduler enqueue/dequeue with backpressure tag
perf: batch metrics and add sampling to avoid high cardinality
test: e2e bench for synthetic kernel saturation
review_comments: Marcus Diaz: Can we avoid emitting per-invocation tags that increase cardinality? Suggest adding a sampled backpressure.reason and restricting gpu_id label cardinality.
Ava Chen: Addressed — added sampling and coalesced gpu_id into device_group label for the collector. Updated tests to assert label cardinality remains bounded.
Priya Iyer: Nit: prefer histogram buckets aligned with kernel latencies observed in perf lab (5ms, 10ms, 25ms, 50ms, 100ms, 250ms, 500ms). Also asked for a clear rollback flag.
Ava Chen: Updated histogram buckets and added telemetry.enable_gpu_queue_metrics=false default and telemetry.force_disable_gpu_traces for emergency rollback.
Liam O'Connor: Verified e2e bench reproduces queueing; approved after CI fixed intermittent flaky test (fixed by increasing test timeout).
release_notes: Instrumented GPU scheduling queue metrics and backpressure traces: new Prometheus collectors, OTLP spans at enqueue/dequeue, Grafana panels for queue depth and kernel wait times, and an alert rule to detect kernel saturation. Feature is gated and disabled by default.
